title: Whether and how nestlings of Japanese tits respond to nest predator risk: Testing active and passive growth responses.
authors: Liu QZ, Yu JP, Shao FB et al.
abstract: Nestling growth is known to be passively constrained by parental feeding and actively mediated by growth-regulating hormones. While nest predation pressures can vary across geographic regions, few studies have focused on whether and how nestling growth patterns are adjusted in response to differences in predation pressure.
